g.text: • High-Definition Optical Webcams (Front/Back) • Thermal Receipt / Badge Esc/POS Printers

BLOCK 5: PHYSICAL GATE CONTROL & AUDIT SUBSYSTEM

BLOCK 6: CLOUD DATA PERSISTENCE & EXTERNAL APIS
